# 02/11/2026 updated using gsekegg()
## prep
```{r}
library(enrichplot)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(dplyr)

collapse_scca_to_gene <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(Gene), !is.na(U_weight), !is.na(PairScore)) %>%
    group_by(Gene) %>%
    # choose the strongest pair per gene (max PairScore)
    slice_max(order_by = PairScore, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      score = sign(U_weight) * log10(1 + PairScore)   # recommended
      # alternative: score = U_weight
      # alternative: score = sign(U_weight) * abs(U_weight)
    )
}
```
```{r}
## mapping
map_gene_to_entrez <- function(gene_df) {
  mapped <- bitr(
    gene_df$Gene,
    fromType = "ENSEMBL",
    toType = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL"),
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
  )

  gene_df %>%
    left_join(mapped, by = c("Gene" = "ENSEMBL")) %>%
    mutate(entrez = suppressWarnings(as.integer(ENTREZID))) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(entrez), !is.na(score)) %>%
    # ensure unique entrez for geneList
    group_by(entrez) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = abs(score), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```
```{r}
run_gsekegg_from_scca <- function(scca_df,
                                 pvalueCutoff = 1,
                                 minGSSize = 10,
                                 maxGSSize = 500) {

  gene_level <- collapse_scca_to_gene(scca_df)
  gene_mapped <- map_gene_to_entrez(gene_level)

  geneList <- gene_mapped$score
  names(geneList) <- as.character(gene_mapped$entrez)
  geneList <- sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

  # for cnetplot coloring
  foldChange <- geneList

  gse <- gseKEGG(
    geneList      = geneList,
    organism      = "hsa",
    keyType       = "ncbi-geneid",
    pvalueCutoff  = pvalueCutoff,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    minGSSize     = minGSSize,
    maxGSSize     = maxGSSize,
    verbose       = FALSE
  )

  list(gse = gse, geneList = geneList, foldChange = foldChange, gene_mapped = gene_mapped)
}
```

```{r}
gsekegg_scca_ileum <- out_scca_ileum$gse
```

```{r}
entrez2sym <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = as.character(unique(kegg_core_long$ENTREZID)),
  keytype = "ENTREZID",
  columns = c("SYMBOL")
) %>%
  transmute(
    ENTREZID = suppressWarnings(as.integer(ENTREZID)),
    SYMBOL = SYMBOL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID), !is.na(SYMBOL)) %>%
  distinct()
```
```{r}
# Map Ensembl -> Entrez + Symbol (Symbol optional but handy)
ens_map <- bitr(
  unique(ileum_df$Gene),
  fromType = "ENSEMBL",
  toType = c("ENTREZID", "SYMBOL"),
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db
) %>%
  transmute(
    Gene = ENSEMBL,
    ENTREZID = suppressWarnings(as.integer(ENTREZID)),
    SYMBOL_fromEns = SYMBOL
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID)) %>%
  distinct(Gene, ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)

scca_ileum_mapped <- ileum_df %>%
  left_join(ens_map, by = "Gene") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENTREZID))
head(scca_ileum_mapped)
```
```{r}
scca_kegg_join <- kegg_core_long %>%
  inner_join(scca_ileum_mapped, by = "ENTREZID") %>%
  left_join(entrez2sym, by = "ENTREZID") %>%
  mutate(
    GeneSymbol = coalesce(SYMBOL, SYMBOL_fromEns)  # prefer Entrez mapping; fallback to Ensembl mapping
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(GeneSymbol))
dim(scca_kegg_join)
head(scca_kegg_join)
```
```{r}
ng <- 5
nm <- 3

top_genes <- scca_kegg_join %>%
  group_by(Pathway, GeneSymbol) %>%
  summarise(U = mean(U_weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Pathway) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(U), n = ng, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

top_microbes <- scca_kegg_join %>%
  group_by(Pathway, Microbe) %>%
  summarise(V = mean(V_weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(Pathway) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs(V), n = nm, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

scca_kegg_keep <- scca_kegg_join %>%
  semi_join(top_genes, by = c("Pathway", "GeneSymbol")) %>%
  semi_join(top_microbes, by = c("Pathway", "Microbe"))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ragg)
library(magick)
library(png)

save_ibd_panel_safe <- function(plot, file_base,
                                width = 190, height = 160,
                                units = "mm", dpi = 600) {
  
  png_file  <- paste0(file_base, ".png")
  rgb_tiff  <- paste0(file_base, "_RGB.tiff")
  cmyk_tiff <- paste0(file_base, "_CMYK.tiff")
  
  # Step 1: save high-res PNG first
  ggsave(
    filename = png_file,
    plot = plot,
    device = ragg::agg_png,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = units,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  
  # Step 2: read PNG and flatten background
  img <- image_read(png_file)
  img <- image_background(img, "white", flatten = TRUE)
  
  # Step 3: write RGB TIFF (most stable)
  image_write(
    img,
    path = rgb_tiff,
    format = "tiff",
    compression = "lzw",
    density = paste0(dpi, "x", dpi)
  )
  
  # Step 4: try CMYK TIFF
  img_cmyk <- image_convert(img, colorspace = "cmyk", type = "truecolor")
  image_write(
    img_cmyk,
    path = cmyk_tiff,
    format = "tiff",
    compression = "lzw",
    density = paste0(dpi, "x", dpi)
  )
  
  cat("RGB TIFF info:\n")
  print(image_info(image_read(rgb_tiff)))
  
  cat("CMYK TIFF info:\n")
  print(image_info(image_read(cmyk_tiff)))
}
```

## Visual from GO

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

# 1) Keep just pathway + symbol (deduplicated)
pw_sym <- res_long %>%
  transmute(Pathway = Description, SYMBOL = Symbol) %>%
  distinct()

# 2) Map SYMBOL -> ENSEMBL (one-to-many possible)
sym2ens <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys    = unique(pw_sym$SYMBOL),
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  columns = c("ENSEMBL")
) %>%
  mutate(ENSEMBL = sub("\\.\\d+$", "", ENSEMBL)) %>%  # safety: strip version if present
  distinct(SYMBOL, ENSEMBL)

# 3) Join; keep rows with a found Ensembl ID
pw_sym_ens <- pw_sym %>%
  left_join(sym2ens, by = "SYMBOL") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ENSEMBL))

# Preview & save
pw_sym_ens
#readr::write_csv(pw_sym_ens, "pathway_gene_symbol_ensembl.csv")

```

### plot
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(ggplot2)

# use your merged/filtered table:
df_in <- ileum_pw_join   # <- change if your object is named differently

# build a long table for plotting: one row per entity (gene or microbe)
plot_long <- bind_rows(
  df_in %>% transmute(Pathway, EntityType = "Gene",    Entity = SYMBOL,  Weight = U_weight),
  df_in %>% transmute(Pathway, EntityType = "Microbe", Entity = Microbe, Weight = V_weight)
) %>%
  distinct() %>%                       # drop duplicates if any
  group_by(Pathway, EntityType, Entity) %>%
  summarise(Weight = mean(Weight, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%  # collapse if repeated
  group_by(Pathway, EntityType) %>%
  mutate(rank = rank(-abs(Weight), ties.method = "first")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    # microbes first (rank stays the same), genes after microbes
    plot_order = if_else(EntityType == "Microbe", rank, max(rank) + rank),
    Entity = fct_reorder(Entity, plot_order, .desc = TRUE)
  )
  # group_by(Pathway, EntityType) %>%
  # mutate(Entity = fct_reorder(Entity, abs(Weight), .desc = TRUE)) %>%   # order by |weight|
  # ungroup()

# plot: each pathway alone (rows), genes vs microbes (columns)
p <- ggplot(plot_long, aes(y = Entity, x = 1)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = abs(Weight), color = Weight), alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_grid(Pathway ~ EntityType, scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 8, name = "|weight|") +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 0, name = "direction") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Ileum sCCA weights within selected GO pathways",
       subtitle = "Genes (u) and microbes (v): size = |weight|, color = sign") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")
  )

print(p)
```
